text.p: Veeco Instruments Inc said on Thursday that the outlook for the next quarter or two will be "challenging."

"The book to bill ratio of .76 for the (third) quarter is reflective of the recent declining order rate of the overall semiconductor capital equipment marketplace, and would indicate a challenging outlook for the next quarter or two," chairman, president and chief executive officer Edward Braun said in a statement.

"We continue to be encouraged by the acceptance of our new products, and the continued long term growth prospects of the industry, particularly for next generation hard drive and advanced semiconductor applications," the company said.

In Veeco's fourth quarter last year, the company a year ago reported a profit of $0.39 a share on sales of $22.3 million. In the company's first quarter, the company reported profits of $0.31 a share on sales of $20.6 million.
